headline: Anthropic's public S-1 and the financing questions around it ran alongside Big Tech earnings, a memory-chip boom and a smaller OpenAI raise.

themes.title: Anthropic's IPO under scrutiny
themes.summary: Anthropic made its S-1 public with a Nasdaq ticker of ANT, and the following days brought scrutiny of its public-benefit structure, a reported high-yield credit rating expectation, and filing-derived gross margin figures.

themes.title: Big Tech earnings and the AI bill
themes.summary: Microsoft, Amazon and Intel reported quarters in which AI demand lifted cloud and data-center revenue, while Meta launched a large equity raise to fund AI infrastructure.

themes.title: Memory and chip supply boom
themes.summary: SK hynix, Sandisk and Samsung reported strong results tied to AI memory demand, and FuriosaAI raised a Series D.

themes.title: Funding and data-center friction
themes.summary: OpenAI cut its pre-IPO round target, DeepSeek's second round was reported at a RMB615.5B valuation, and banks shelved a bond for an Anthropic-tied Texas data center as state grid review froze new projects.

notes: Built from titles of the week's daily items; see each item for caveats.
